source_segments.text: of use since 1923 and is privately owned.
History [edit] Beacon Mill is one of two windmills marked on the 1819-43 Ordnance Survey map.
It was also marked on Greenwood's 1821 map.
Towards the end of the nineteenth century, Beacon Mill was run in conjunction with Wandle Mill, on the River Rother.
[2] The mill was last worked for trade in 1955 and the sails and fantail were removed in 1923.
Two of the sails were re-erected on the White Mill at Headcorn.
